title: Bare done and evaluate refuse while the session holds more than one live claim
outcome: Bare done and evaluate refuse while the session holds more than one live claim
acceptance: Through the CLI and MCP, a bare `done` or bare `evaluate` (no explicit work ref) from a session holding more than one live claim is refused with a typed reason that lists the held refs and gives the exact explicit command; nothing is recorded.
With exactly one live claim, or with an explicit ref, both words behave as today.
Tests cover all three cases on the CLI and MCP surfaces, and the docs state the rule.

completion.summary:
A bare done or evaluate from a session whose held focus has another live claim beside it is now refused with work_bare_target_ambiguous. The refusal names the focus and every held ref, offers the explicit commands, and records nothing; it is checked before any write and before evaluate's attempt replay. A focus the session does not hold keeps the older implicit-target refusal. One claim, an explicit ref or an explicit retry act as before, and bare note, gate and handoff are unchanged.
